items.title: Sarawak Presents RM500,000 Aid To Five FDS Victims’ Families
items.summary: At a Kuching ceremony, Sarawak Premier Abang Jo presents RM100,000 cheques to each family of 5 victims killed in the Long Lellang tragedy, besides education sponsorships for their kids. One of the widows, Stephanie, says Sarawak helped a lot from Day One. The post Sarawak Presents RM500,000 Aid To Five FDS Victims’ Families appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Revert To Pre-2016 For True ‘Abolition’ Of Contract Doctor System
items.summary: To truly “abolish” the contract doctor system, all medical graduates entering housemanship in 2027 should be automatically made permanent staff on Day One of training — reverting back to pre-2016 — so that 2026 will mark the last contract doctor cohorts. items.title: Mandate Mediation For Medical Negligence Complaints Before Lawsuits, Says APHM
items.summary: APHM's Dr Kuljit Singh wants medical negligence disputes to undergo mandatory mediation before suing. He says litigation fears are also driving defensive medicine and higher health care utilisation. Doctors can't use cost-saving for patients as a defence. items.title: Putrajaya Paying RM130,000 Each To Four FDS Crash Victims’ Families
items.summary: MOH announces federal lump-sum payments of at least RM130,000 to each family of its four staff killed in the Long Lellang tragedy. But MOH didn't mention any payment from Putrajaya for the family of the fifth victim, the pilot, who was a private worker.
